title: Memory
subtitle: View, correct, and forget the agent's persistent memory; turning it off keeps existing data.

mode.label: Memory mode
mode.automaticNeedsModel: Automatic mode requires an extraction model

search.degraded: Short term matched via substring fallback

list.empty: No memories yet. Ask the agent to remember something explicit, or wait for automatic consolidation.

correct.title: Correct memory
correct.conflict: Version conflict: this memory was updated. Reopen it and try again.

forget.title: Forget this memory?
forget.description: Deletes all versions and blocks re-extraction from old sources; original conversations are not deleted.
forget.alsoProcessSources: Also process original conversation sources (existing flow)
